apariciones.subtitulo: Tilting sympathy without taking sides

mision.consigna: Write two portraits of the same person absorbed in a hobby: one that makes the reader admire them, one that makes the reader wince — without a single evaluative adjective.
requisitos: the same facts in both versions
a consistent thread of charged verbs in each
no *good*, *bad*, *admirable*, *annoying* or similar
use *to be engrossed in*, *to lose track of time* and *an avid reader*

microtareas.texto: Take *she talks about her hobby a lot* and write it five ways, from warm to withering.
Rewrite a neutral paragraph about someone who *dabbles in* everything so the reader distrusts them.
Record 2 minutes describing *a flow state* you know, tilting the listener without saying what you think.

apariciones.subtitulo: Offering the interpretation as a hypothesis

mision.consigna: Give feedback to a colleague whose newsletter pieces have started to read as one-sided.
requisitos: observation and interpretation explicitly separated
the interpretation offered as something they can correct
one question that genuinely hands them the floor
use *editorial slant*, *to be skewed* and *to sensationalise*

microtareas.texto: Write three observations about a text you disagree with — no interpretation at all.
Add your interpretation to each as a hypothesis: *My guess is…, but tell me if that's off.*
Record 2 minutes giving feedback on a piece of *clickbait* as if to its author.

apariciones.subtitulo: Linking by leaving the links out

mision.consigna: Write a short account of arriving somewhere whose unwritten rules you didn't know.
requisitos: at least one passage of bare juxtaposition where a marker would be expected
one marker used precisely because its absence would mislead
one *That, in itself, was the answer*-type pivot
use *unwritten rules*, *to be taken aback* and *to acclimatise*

microtareas.texto: Write five linked sentences about a *faux pas*. Delete every marker. Which deletions work?
Put back only the ones the logic truly needs.
Record 2 minutes on feeling *disorientated* abroad. Notice where you reach for *so* and *but* by habit.

apariciones.subtitulo: Running the conversation, not just your turns

mision.consigna: Describe how you would steer a dinner conversation about money where one person dominates and another says nothing.
requisitos: drawing in a silent participant without spotlighting them
one redirection that is never announced as such
one repair of a misunderstanding between two others
use *disposable income*, *to be frugal* and *to live hand to mouth*

microtareas.texto: Write three ways to bring someone in without *You haven't said anything*.
Write a redirect that sounds like a continuation, not a correction.
Record 2 minutes on *a windfall*: what would you do with it? Invite the listener in twice.

apariciones.subtitulo: Six axes of register, one at a time

mision.consigna: Review the same restaurant three times: for a food magazine, a friend's group chat and a complaint to the owner.
requisitos: register controlled on at least four axes (contractions, vocabulary, sentence length, hedging, person, idiom)
one deliberate mismatch on a single axis for effect — and say which
the same facts in all three
use *provenance*, *indulgent* and *to have a discerning palate*

microtareas.texto: Take one sentence about *an acquired taste* and shift it along one axis at a time.
Find a register leak in a restaurant review online and explain which axis slipped.
Record 2 minutes as *a connoisseur* explaining how to *savour* a dish — then 30 seconds as yourself.

apariciones.subtitulo: Compression calibrated to genre

mision.consigna: Describe the same trend in conspicuous consumption as a legal clause, a scientific abstract and a newspaper paragraph.
requisitos: near-total nominalisation in the legal version
an absolute construction in the abstract
a verbal backbone kept in the newspaper version
use *conspicuous consumption*, *status symbol* and *to keep up with the Joneses*

microtareas.texto: Write *People buy things to show others they're rich* in three genres.
Two absolute constructions (*This having been established…*) about *splashing out on* luxury.
Record 2 minutes on *materialistic* values. Hear how much nominalisation speech can bear.

apariciones.subtitulo: Dropping register on purpose inside a formal text

mision.consigna: Write a formal letter to an authority about a process that has left you in limbo — with one deliberate drop into plain speech.
requisitos: a formal frame throughout
one controlled drop into the informal end for rhetorical effect
one *which is a polite way of saying…*
use *red tape*, *to be in limbo* and *to navigate the system*

microtareas.texto: Write the ladder for *get the runaround*: three rungs from phrasal to formal.
Draft the sentence where the register drops. Is it a punch or a slip?
Record 2 minutes describing *a Kafkaesque process* you went through.

apariciones.subtitulo: One hedge, well placed — or none

mision.consigna: Write a short position on whether we have already passed an environmental tipping point.
requisitos: no more than two hedges in the whole text
one claim stated flat, with *I'm sure enough to say so*
one *I'll go out on a limb and say…*
use *a tipping point*, *irreversible* and *to mitigate*

microtareas.texto: Take a paragraph you wrote with many hedges. Cut to one per claim.
Write three claims about *biodiversity* you'd state without any hedge.
Record 2 minutes on *sustainability*. Notice when a hedge starts to sound evasive.

apariciones.subtitulo: A prediction as a scenario tree

mision.consigna: Forecast how school assessment will change in the next decade.
requisitos: the most probable path
at least one credible alternative
the specific signal that would tell you which one is happening
use *rote learning*, *critical thinking* and *to cram*

microtareas.texto: Name the signal you'd watch to know whether *rote learning* is really declining.
Write the alternative scenario in three sentences.
Record 2 minutes: *This will largely hinge on…* — about how people *grasp a concept*.

apariciones.subtitulo: Twisting an idiom for precision

mision.consigna: Write a column about the attention economy that bends at least two fixed idioms on purpose.
requisitos: two idioms modified deliberately, for humour or precision
one idiom used straight, for contrast
the twists recognisable as play, not error
use *the attention economy*, *to be tethered to a device* and *ubiquitous*

microtareas.texto: Take three idioms and twist each so it fits *an echo chamber*.
Ask yourself: which twist would a native reader see as play? Keep that one.
Record 2 minutes on being *hooked* on your phone, with one twisted idiom.

apariciones.subtitulo: Naming their interest before they do

mision.consigna: Negotiate a phased return to work after a long illness with a manager who's nervous about it.
requisitos: name the manager's real interest before they state it
one *Is that a fair read of where you're coming from?*
one concession given freely, not traded
use *a chronic condition*, *a relapse* and *to be on the mend*

microtareas.texto: Write the three interests a manager might have that they won't say aloud.
Write your opening line naming one of them.
Record 2 minutes negotiating from a *holistic* view of your recovery.

apariciones.subtitulo: Wishing someone else would change

mision.consigna: Write a letter you'll never send to a friend who acts as if nothing had happened after hurting you.
requisitos: two *I wish you would…* about ongoing behaviour
one *as if / as though* + past perfect
one *It's high time…*
use *to harbour resentment*, *to bury the hatchet* and *to take someone for granted*

microtareas.texto: Five *I wish he would…* sentences — critiques, not daydreams.
Two sentences with *acts as though he had…*.
Record 2 minutes on friends who *drift apart*. One *It's about time…*

apariciones.subtitulo: Mixed conditionals: a past choice, a present result

mision.consigna: Write about a career decision you made years ago and where it has left you now.
requisitos: three mixed conditionals, past condition → present result
one present condition → past result (*If I weren't so…, I would have…*)
one *Had things gone differently…*
use *to be pigeonholed*, *a sideways move* and *to climb the career ladder*

microtareas.texto: Write three *If I had…, I'd be… now* about your work.
Write one reversed: a trait of yours that changed a past outcome.
Record 2 minutes: if you'd been *headhunted* five years ago, where would you be?

apariciones.subtitulo: Knowing when to drop the irony

mision.consigna: Write about the housing crisis in your city in a wry tone — and switch to complete sincerity at one point.
requisitos: understatement for most of the text
one clear, marked switch to directness
the reason for the switch evident to the reader
use *to be priced out*, *to displace residents* and *a housing crisis*

microtareas.texto: Write three understated lines about *gentrification*.
Write the one sentence where irony would be wrong.
Record 2 minutes on trying *to get on the property ladder*. Say *In all seriousness* once — mean it.

apariciones.subtitulo: Premise, logic or conclusion — disagree with the right part

mision.consigna: Respond to the claim that quiet quitting shows a generation that doesn't want to work.
requisitos: name which part you contest: premise, logic or conclusion
one part you explicitly grant
one *That's a separate question from…*
use *quiet quitting*, *to be disengaged* and *a glass ceiling*

microtareas.texto: Break the claim into premise, logic and conclusion in three lines.
Write one sentence attacking each — then pick the strongest.
Record 2 minutes disagreeing about *presenteeism*. Grant something first.

apariciones.subtitulo: Phrasal verbs whose meaning has drifted

mision.consigna: Write about a company that got away with greenwashing for years.
requisitos: five figurative phrasal verbs, two with three parts
no Latinate substitute where the phrasal is the natural choice
one *come up against*
use *greenwashing*, *carbon offsetting* and *to pay lip service to*

microtareas.texto: Ten three-part phrasal verbs: write the literal parts and the actual meaning.
Three sentences about companies that *look down on* critics.
Record 2 minutes on *carbon offsetting*: who *gets away with* what?

apariciones.subtitulo: Retiring your own tics

mision.consigna: Write a paragraph about standardised testing, then rewrite it removing your favourite sentence pattern.
requisitos: identify one structure you overuse (e.g. *not only… but also*, triplets)
the rewrite without it
one sentence stated without qualification
use *standardised testing*, *to teach to the test* and *to stifle creativity*

microtareas.texto: Read three things you wrote this month. Which sentence shape recurs?
Rewrite five sentences about *critical thinking* without that shape.
Record 2 minutes on *rote learning*. Listen for your spoken tic.

apariciones.subtitulo: An opinion framed by its own confidence

mision.consigna: Give your view on whether we live in a post-truth era.
requisitos: acknowledge the difficulty before answering
signal exactly how firmly you hold the view
one *I could be persuaded otherwise by…* with a specific condition
use *a post-truth era*, *disinformation* and *to debunk*

microtareas.texto: Write your view in one line. Above it, why the question is hard.
Write what evidence would move you.
Record 2 minutes on *editorial slant*: *If pressed, I'd say…*

apariciones.subtitulo: Collocations of the policy brief

mision.consigna: Write the executive summary of a proposal to digitalise a public service.
requisitos: six professional collocations from the reference box
no near-synonym that breaks a pairing (*make a conclusion*, *reduce a risk*)
one *strike a balance*
use *digitalisation*, *to streamline* and *a user-centred approach*

microtareas.texto: Ten nouns from policy writing with their fixed verb.
Three sentences with *pose a challenge* and *mitigate a risk* about *red tape*.
Record 2 minutes on how to *navigate the system*, collocations counted.

apariciones.subtitulo: Misdirecting the listener, then resolving

mision.consigna: Tell a story about the moment you realised an app had been shaping what you saw.
requisitos: one deliberate false lead the listener believes
the reveal placed for maximum effect
one *At the time, I assumed… It wasn't.*
use *algorithmic bias*, *opaque* and *an echo chamber*

microtareas.texto: Write what the listener should believe halfway through.
Write the single line that overturns it.
Record 2 minutes of the story about *the attention economy*. Control what they know when.

apariciones.subtitulo: One hedge word, one point on the scale

mision.consigna: Write the findings paragraph of a report on food insecurity in a wealthy country.
requisitos: four hedges, each signalling a different degree of certainty
one *would appear to* and one *cannot be ruled out*
one sentence saying why you chose that hedge
use *food insecurity*, *ultra-processed* and *to be malnourished*

microtareas.texto: Rank *may*, *would appear to*, *there is reason to believe* from weakest to strongest.
Rewrite three claims about *provenance* labelling at precise certainty levels.
Record 2 minutes on *ultra-processed* food, choosing each hedge deliberately.

apariciones.subtitulo: Alternating emphasis across an argument

mision.consigna: Write an argumentative passage on whether we should judge other cultures by our own standards.
requisitos: inversion, cleft and fronting, alternating — no device twice in a row
one *Nowhere is this clearer than in…*
one sentence deliberately without emphasis
use *cultural relativism*, *ethnocentric* and *to challenge assumptions*

microtareas.texto: Draft the argument plain. Mark the three sentences that deserve weight.
Assign a different device to each.
Record 2 minutes on *unwritten rules* abroad. One inversion, one cleft.

apariciones.subtitulo: The same summary for two different audiences

mision.consigna: Summarise the research on deliberate practice twice: for a coach and for a curious teenager.
requisitos: shared background compressed aggressively for the expert
the genuinely new part expanded for each audience
one *I'll assume you know…, so let's focus on…*
use *deliberate practice*, *mastery* and *to hone a craft*

microtareas.texto: List what a coach already knows about *mastery*. Cut it.
Write what a teenager needs explained that the coach doesn't.
Record 2 minutes on *a flow state* for someone new to it.

apariciones.subtitulo: Scenario tree for your own health

mision.consigna: Forecast how preventive health care will change for people with chronic conditions.
requisitos: the most probable path, a credible alternative and a wildcard
the signal that distinguishes them, different from last time
one *…can't be excluded*
use *a chronic condition*, *self-care* and *holistic*

microtareas.texto: Write the wildcard in two sentences.
Name the one statistic you'd watch.
Record 2 minutes on *burnout* trends. *If that turns, the picture changes.*

apariciones.subtitulo: Connotation that argues for you

mision.consigna: Write a product review of a phone that sounds neutral but steers the reader against planned obsolescence.
requisitos: no stated opinion
a thread of charged words doing the arguing
one near-synonym pair where you explain your choice
use *planned obsolescence*, *the right to repair* and *a throwaway culture*

microtareas.texto: Ten neutral words about gadgets; give each a loaded near-synonym.
Rewrite a manufacturer's claim about *status symbols* in charged but neutral-looking words.
Record 2 minutes on *conspicuous consumption*, never saying what you think.

apariciones.subtitulo: Feedback on an urban plan, as a hypothesis

mision.consigna: Give feedback to a council planner on a densification proposal for your neighbourhood.
requisitos: observations separated from interpretation, with a different framing from last time
one interpretation you explicitly invite them to correct
one *Does that match what's happening on your end?*
use *densification*, *urban planning* and *a sense of community*

microtareas.texto: Write three things you noticed in the plan, no judgement.
Turn one into a hypothesis about *displacing residents*.
Record 2 minutes of feedback on *gentrification* risks.

apariciones.subtitulo: When to link and when to let silence link

mision.consigna: Write a reflective piece about the mental load in a relationship.
requisitos: two passages of bare juxtaposition
markers only where their absence would confuse
one *Which is to say,*
use *the mental load*, *emotional labour* and *reciprocity*

microtareas.texto: Write about *being taken advantage of* in five sentences with no connectors.
Add one marker. Does it help or explain too much?
Record 2 minutes on *harbouring resentment*; notice your habitual *and so*.

apariciones.subtitulo: Steering a meeting that's drifted

mision.consigna: Describe how you'd chair a public consultation on digital services where the discussion keeps drifting into complaints.
requisitos: one unannounced redirection, different from last time
drawing in someone from the back without putting them on the spot
a repair between two speakers talking past each other
use *public trust*, *transparency* and *the social contract*

microtareas.texto: Write three redirections that sound like continuations.
Write how you'd repair a misunderstanding about *digitalisation*.
Record 2 minutes chairing a talk on *red tape*. *We got a bit sidetracked, but…*

apariciones.subtitulo: Register on six axes: explaining investment

mision.consigna: Explain compound interest three ways: to a child, to a colleague at lunch and in a bank's information leaflet.
requisitos: each version distinct on at least four axes
one axis kept identical across all three on purpose
the same core facts
use *compound interest*, *to diversify* and *volatility*

microtareas.texto: Write one sentence about *volatility* at six register points.
Identify which axis you find hardest to control.
Record 2 minutes on why people *squander* savings — then 30 seconds as a leaflet.

apariciones.subtitulo: Compression for a planning document

mision.consigna: Write the background section of an urban planning report on rootless neighbourhoods.
requisitos: an absolute construction and two participle clauses
nominalisation calibrated to a planning report, not a legal text
one sentence you decompressed because the density hurt it
use *urban planning*, *anonymity* and *to put down roots*

microtareas.texto: Compress five sentences about *a sense of community* into two.
Decompress the densest one for a public leaflet.
Record 2 minutes on feeling *rootless*. Speech keeps its verbs.

apariciones.subtitulo: Apposition and absolute constructions

mision.consigna: Write a profile of someone who turned a side hustle into mastery.
requisitos: two noun phrases in apposition
two absolute constructions with their own subject
one fixed absolute (*weather permitting*, *time allowing*)
use *a side hustle*, *to monetise* and *to lose the joy*

microtareas.texto: Five sentences about *deliberate practice* with an appositive.
Three absolute constructions: *Her savings gone, she…*.
Record 2 minutes on *honing a craft*, one absolute construction.

apariciones.subtitulo: Hedging a charge of complicity

mision.consigna: Write about whether ordinary consumers are complicit in exploitative supply chains.
requisitos: no more than two hedges, both deliberate
one claim stated flat because you're sure
one *and I don't say that lightly*
use *to be complicit in*, *supply chain transparency* and *ethical consumerism*

microtareas.texto: Write three claims about *ethical consumerism*. Decide which deserve a hedge.
Remove every hedge from one and see if it still holds.
Record 2 minutes on *the right to repair*. *There's no need to hedge this:*

apariciones.subtitulo: Register ladder in family obligations

mision.consigna: Write about caring for ageing parents, moving between conversational and academic register on purpose.
requisitos: three register ladders (phrasal → Latinate → fixed collocation)
one deliberate drop into plain speech in an otherwise formal paragraph
one *In plainer terms,*
use *filial duty*, *intergenerational* and *the nuclear family*

microtareas.texto: Build the ladder for *look after*, *take on* and *put up with*.
Write about *emotional labour* in academic register, then drop once.
Record 2 minutes on *reciprocity* in families.

apariciones.subtitulo: Idioms bent around food

mision.consigna: Write a food essay on culinary heritage in which one fixed idiom is bent to fit the theme.
requisitos: two idioms, one twisted
the twist obviously intentional
one *not to put too fine a point on it,*
use *culinary heritage*, *commensality* and *to be steeped in ritual*

microtareas.texto: Take three food-free idioms and bend each around *provenance*.
Test: would a native reader smile or frown?
Record 2 minutes on *food insecurity* — no playful idioms here. Why?

apariciones.subtitulo: Allegedly or reportedly — the legal weight

mision.consigna: Write a news brief about a (fictional) university accused of rigging admissions.
requisitos: *allegedly* and *reportedly* each used where the difference matters
one reported statement deliberately not backshifted, and why
one *The allegations remain unproven*
use *socioeconomic background*, *meritocratic* and *to widen access*

microtareas.texto: Write three sentences with *allegedly*, then with *reportedly*. Which exposes you more?
Write *He maintains that he is…* vs *He claimed he had been…* about *standardised testing*.
Record 2 minutes reporting the story neutrally.

apariciones.subtitulo: Negotiating over an inheritance

mision.consigna: Negotiate with a sibling how to divide an inheritance fairly.
requisitos: name their unspoken interest, different approach from last time
one *Let's treat this as a shared problem*
one concession that asks for nothing
use *inherited wealth*, *inequality* and *the wealth gap*

microtareas.texto: Write what your sibling fears most and won't say.
Write the offer you'd make before they ask.
Record 2 minutes on *compound interest* and fairness between siblings.

apariciones.subtitulo: Mixed conditionals about public trust

mision.consigna: A younger relative asks why adults argue so badly about the news. Explain how the present state of public debate grew out of choices made over the past twenty years.
requisitos: three mixed conditionals, different from last time
one *If it weren't for…, we wouldn't have…*
one *…, and that's why we're… today*
use *polarisation*, *public discourse* and *to erode trust*

microtareas.texto: Three *If X had…, we would be…* sentences about *disinformation*.
One reversed conditional: a present trait with a past result.
Record 2 minutes on *a post-truth era*. Look back and land in the present.

apariciones.subtitulo: Sustained inversion across a passage

mision.consigna: Write a short speech about what really motivates people at work.
requisitos: three rare inversion patterns (*Rarely, if ever*, *Never before had*, *So … was … that*)
one cleft combined with an inversion in the same passage
the devices spread across several sentences
use *autonomy*, *a sense of purpose* and *to be intrinsically motivated*

microtareas.texto: Write five inversions about *presenteeism*.
Choose three that work in speech. Drop the rest.
Record 2 minutes on *quiet quitting*: *Only when… did…*

apariciones.subtitulo: Disagreeing about who carries the burden

mision.consigna: Respond to the claim that individuals shouldn't have to shoulder the burden of climate action.
requisitos: contest a specific part, different from last time
one *The reasoning holds, but the conclusion overreaches*
one *We may simply be starting from different premises*
use *collective action*, *intergenerational justice* and *to shoulder the burden*

microtareas.texto: Split the claim into premise, logic, conclusion.
Write what you'd grant and what you'd contest.
Record 2 minutes on companies that *pay lip service to* change.

apariciones.subtitulo: Wry about health, sincere where it counts

mision.consigna: Write about your own relationship with self-care, wryly — with one moment of plain honesty.
requisitos: understatement throughout, different devices from last time
one marked drop into sincerity
no irony in the sincere part
use *self-care*, *burnout* and *a sedentary lifestyle*

microtareas.texto: Write three understated lines about *longevity* trends.
Write the one sentence you won't joke about.
Record 2 minutes on *preventive medicine*. *I'm not going to make light of this.*

apariciones.subtitulo: Patterns, not just words: writing about AI

mision.consigna: Write a paragraph on whether AI will supplant or augment professionals — then cut every rhetorical move you use by default.
requisitos: name two of your habitual moves (e.g. rhetorical question, triplet)
the final version without them
one flat, unhedged statement
use *to supplant*, *to augment human capabilities* and *obsolete*

microtareas.texto: Underline your habitual moves in something you wrote about *algorithmic bias*.
Rewrite it without them.
Record 2 minutes on *accountability*; listen for spoken tics.

apariciones.subtitulo: Phrasal verbs for travel ethics

mision.consigna: Write about overtourism and what visitors can get away with.
requisitos: five figurative phrasal verbs, different from last time
two three-part phrasal verbs
no Latinate substitute where the phrasal is natural
use *overtourism*, *to commodify* and *authenticity*

microtareas.texto: Ten phrasal verbs you'd use to talk about *cultural relativism*.
Three sentences with *come up against* and *look down on*.
Record 2 minutes on how travel *commodifies* places.

apariciones.subtitulo: Collocations for a fiscal argument

mision.consigna: Write the conclusion of a policy paper on taxing wealth.
requisitos: six professional collocations, different from last time
one *yield a result* and one *pose a threat*
no broken pairing
use *a wealth tax*, *fiscal responsibility* and *to incentivise*

microtareas.texto: Ten nouns from economics with their fixed verb.
Three sentences about *the wealth gap* with *draw a conclusion*.
Record 2 minutes on *inequality*. Count collocations after.

apariciones.subtitulo: An opinion on having less

mision.consigna: Give your view on whether voluntary simplicity is a real answer or a privilege.
requisitos: the complexity acknowledged first, differently from last time
one *I hold that view fairly loosely*
one condition that would change your mind
use *degrowth*, *voluntary simplicity* and *to be content with less*

microtareas.texto: Write the strongest case against your view.
Write how confidently you really hold it — honestly.
Record 2 minutes on *a throwaway culture*: *I'd lean towards…*

apariciones.subtitulo: Calibrated caution on regulating AI

mision.consigna: Write the conclusions of a white paper on regulating AI in hiring.
requisitos: hedges placed at precise certainty levels, different words from last time
one *It is not inconceivable that…*
one *…remains an open question*
use *an ethical framework*, *to regulate* and *to stifle innovation*

microtareas.texto: Rank five hedges on a certainty scale.
Rewrite three claims about *accountability* at exact levels.
Record 2 minutes on whether AI will *supplant* recruiters.

apariciones.subtitulo: A story that withholds the real point

mision.consigna: Tell a story about waiting for treatment in a two-tier health system.
requisitos: a false lead the listener believes, different from last time
a reveal that reframes the beginning
one *I only found out… years later*
use *a two-tier system*, *equitable access* and *to be underfunded*

microtareas.texto: Write what the listener should assume at the start.
Write the reveal in one sentence.
Record 2 minutes of the story about *preventive medicine*.

apariciones.subtitulo: Summarising for policymakers vs learners

mision.consigna: Summarise the debate on reskilling for a minister and for a worker about to lose their job.
requisitos: different compression for each audience
one *The part that actually matters here is…*
no background the minister already knows
use *to reskill*, *lifelong learning* and *socioeconomic background*

microtareas.texto: What does the minister already know about *meritocratic* systems? Cut it.
What does the worker need that the minister doesn't?
Record 2 minutes on *widening access* for someone new to the topic.

apariciones.subtitulo: Emphasis in an essay on idleness

mision.consigna: Write an essay in praise of doing nothing.
requisitos: inversion, cleft and fronting alternating, different patterns from last time
one *It is precisely this that…*
one plain sentence as a resting point
use *the art of doing nothing*, *to be overscheduled* and *to reclaim your time*

microtareas.texto: Draft plainly. Mark three sentences that need weight.
Give each a different device.
Record 2 minutes on *losing the joy* in hobbies. One fronting.
